title: File:Arctic sea ice varied (7873355004).jpg
art: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center from Greenbelt, MD, USA
desc:
Sea ice can take many forms, as seen in this image of Arctic sea ice from the DMS instrument from a recent Operation IceBridge aerial survey.  Varying thicknesses of sea ice are shown here, from thin, nearly transparent layers to thicker, older sea ice covered with snow.
To read more go to: 1.usa.go

title: File:Arctic Sea Ice Lead (7873353514).jpg
art: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center from Greenbelt, MD, USA
desc:
Cracks between sheets of sea ice are called leads, as as seen in this image of Arctic sea ice from the DMS instrument from a recent Operation IceBridge aerial survey.
To read more go to: 1.usa.gov/PkgRuq
